cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Raise the Impossibility
cards.instruction: Answer every strange offer with a more committed version that you can still justify.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: For my restaurant, your flying chair needs a flying table. Dinner should travel with the diner.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I can make the whole table circle the room.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll supply the waiter if you can make him hover. Nobody should chase their soup.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The waiter can serve while flying upside down.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'll change the menu to gravity-proof soup. Keep the customers upright.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 leads restaurant design; A3 contributes a waiter to obtain hovering service and A5 commits menu change while keeping customer comfort as the governing demand.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 circling table causes A3 hovering service; B4 inverted waiter causes A5 gravity-proof soup and upright customers.

relationship.evidence: B2 and B4 improve the supplier offer rather than merely obstructing A.

heightening.evidence: A5 the food itself must now resist gravity because B escalates the waiter ability.

specificity.evidence: A1 restaurant and dinner define why chair, table and waiter must coordinate.

brevityWit.evidence: A3 staff commitment and A5 menu commitment are actual cooperative terms; each rationale serves B design task.
